verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a Marketing API whose root resource links to every other resource, along with audience endpoints and a full account-export endpoint, so an agent can programmatically pull the email program. Open/click reporting and the in-product Analytics AI (which explains which campaigns and automations drive revenue) cover the 'what's working' angle, but the evidence shows these only as in-app features, not as data an external agent can retrieve. The 'use the AI you already use' chat integration is documented for creating campaigns, not for reporting. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for reading live automations, explicit campaign-report/results endpoints, evidence an external agent can query performance or analytics data, and independent hands-on corroboration.
